# Pure Marketing

> Pure Marketing is a local lead generation and customer acquisition agency based in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada. We help Canadian local service businesses (contractors, electricians, plumbers, painters, roofers, HVAC companies, exterior/siding contractors, locksmiths) generate more qualified calls, estimates, and booked jobs through one coordinated system: paid advertising, Google Maps and local search visibility, AI search discoverability, and lead capture and conversion. No long-term contracts. Pricing is discussed privately after a free local growth assessment.

## Our System

- [Local Lead Generation System](https://puremarketing.ca/services/lead-generation): Our one flagship service. Combines Google Ads, Google Local Service Ads, Meta Ads, Google Business Profile and Maps optimization, local SEO, AI search discoverability, and lead capture/conversion tracking into a single customer acquisition system. Not sold as separate services or packages.

## Industries We Serve

- [Electricians](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/electricians): Local lead generation for electrical repairs, panel upgrades, and EV charger installs.
- [Plumbers](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/plumbers): Local lead generation for plumbing repairs, installations, and emergency calls.
- [HVAC Companies](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/hvac): Local lead generation for heating and cooling companies, built around seasonal demand.
- [Painters](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/painters): Local lead generation for interior/exterior painting estimates and project inquiries.
- [Roofing Companies](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/roofing): Local lead generation for re-roofs, repairs, and storm damage estimates.
- [Exterior & Siding Contractors](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/exterior-services): Local lead generation for siding, soffit, fascia, and exterior renovation projects.
- [Locksmiths](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/locksmiths): Local lead generation for emergency lockout and locksmith services.
- [General Contractors](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/general-contractors): Local lead generation for residential and commercial renovation projects.
